tailwindcss-3.4.17.js is the Tailwind CSS v3.4.17 Play CDN build, copied
unchanged from https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 on 2026-10-25 so the site
no longer runs a third-party script that can change upstream.
sha256 176e894661aa9cdc9a5cba6c720044cbbf7b8bd80d1c9a142a7c24b1b6c50d15

To upgrade: download the new pinned version, check it makes no network
calls, commit it under a new versioned name and point every page's
<script src> at it (all HTML pages plus 404.html).
